result.summary: The 2020 page adds a Sustainability and Diversity & Inclusion emphasis, a 'Core Values' section naming four values (putting clients first, exceptional ideas, doing the right thing, giving back), and a 'Giving Back' core value. It removes the 1935-2013 history timeline, including community and children's health commitments and the 2013-2014 sustainability dedication, and changes the country count from 42 to 41.
